text: Day ten. Here's the myth. In movies, someone throws their phone in a lake, smiles... and life is suddenly perfect. {neutral} In real life, most people don't even make it this far. In a twenty twenty-five study, people blocked the internet on their phones for just two weeks. Only about a quarter lasted even ten of those fourteen days. The first week is the hardest. Your brain keeps asking for its little hits. And boredom... feels almost like pain. So if you're still going on day ten... you're already rare.
